title: No More Dead Air: The Pause Now Sets the Pace | vitalii.no
description:
A kid watching an explainer film used to sit through long stretches where literally nothing on screen was changing — the timeline used to stretch a shot's length just to let a slow camera move finish, even over a sentence that didn't need the extra seconds.

I rewrote supabase/functions/[name]/index.ts's timing engine so a shot is refused outright if it is shorter than the effect needs, instead of being padded up to fit. Every beat's pause is now one of five fixed kinds — line, key, term, diagram, final — each capped at 3 seconds, and planned silence across a whole film can no longer exceed 15 percent of runtime.

A new rule in the engine refuses any shot that stays static for more than 8 seconds, and requires every beat after a shot's first to change something on screen — a camera look, a colour, a layout. Five new effect components back that up, plus a fixed set of colour tokens so a colour always means the same thing across a whole video.
